cards.imageAlt: 液压系统，用于本话题的看图描述和问答
cards.taskTitle: 液压系统 · 看图材料

cards.audioText: Look at the picture, if the right side system failed, what would happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 看这张图片，如果右侧的系统有故障将会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: Well, the normal brakes and the right reverser cannot be used. In that case, the hydraulic pressure of flight control can be supplied by the left and center hydraulic system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正规制动器和右侧反向制动器无法使用。如果是这种情况，飞机控制所需的液压将由左侧和中间的液压系统提供。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of flaps?
cards.referenceText: Flaps exert effects when they are extended so that the wing area is increased. During takeoff, flaps can be used to increase the lift, reduce takeoff distance and lower the rotation speed. During landing, flaps can be used to reduce the landing speed and landing distance by increasing the lift.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机放襟翼时可以增加机翼的面积。起飞时，襟翼能增加升力，减少起飞滑跑距离，降低抬前轮速度。降落时，襟翼可以通过增加升力来降低着陆速度和着陆距离。

cards.audioText: Can you describe the landing gear on your plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下你的飞机上的起落架吗？
cards.referenceText: The landing gear is the primary support of the airplane when parking, taxiing, taking off, or landing. I am flying B737 now. There are two main landing gears and a single nose gear on my plane. Each main gear is a conventional two–wheel landing gear. They are retractable. The nose gear is a conventional steerable two–wheel unit. Normally, the hydraulic pressure of the landing gear is supplied by system A. If system A fails, we can manually extend the landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架在飞机停车、滑行、起飞和降落时为飞机提供主要支撑。我现在驾驶的是波音737，飞机有两个主起落架和一个前起落架。主起落架是传统的双轮起落架，并且能够伸缩，前起落架是传统的可操纵的双轮组。通常起落架的液压由A系统提供，如果A系统故障，我们可以手动放下起落架。

cards.audioText: Have you encountered any problems with the hydraulic pressure system during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾在飞行中遭遇过液压系统故障吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered hydraulic system problem during the real flight, but I often practice this situation in the simulator training. / Yes, I encountered such problem once. That was before our takeoff, my co-pilot reported that our left reverser failed, we aborted takeoff quickly and requested to taxi back to apron for further check and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在实际飞行中从未遭遇过液压系统故障，但是我经常在模拟训练中练习这种场景。/ 有，我曾遭遇过液压系统故障。在起飞前，我的副驾驶向我报告飞机的左侧反向制动器故障，我们立刻中断起飞，并请求滑行回停机坪做进一步检查和维修。

cards.audioText: Can you describe the hydraulic system in Boeing aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下波音飞机的液压系统吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I am flying B737. There are three hydraulic systems in this aircraft, system A, B and alternate hydraulic system. System A supplies pressure to some controls and landing gear related controls, such as gear extension, nose wheel steering, brakes, and power transfer unit. System B supplies pressure to some control surfaces, such as leading edge flaps, slats, normal brakes and so on. If both systems A and B fail, the alternate system will supply hydraulic pressure to some essential equipment so that we can still control the aircraft to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，我现在驾驶的是波音737。飞机有三个液压系统：A系统、B系统和备用液压系统。A系统为操纵装置提供压力，例如起落架收放、前轮转弯、刹车和动力传输组。B系统为一些操纵面提供压力，例如前缘襟翼、前缘缝翼和正规制动器等。如果A系统和B系统都出现了故障，备用液压系统会为主要设备提供压力，飞行员仍然可以控制飞机着陆。

cards.audioText: If both the right and central hydraulic pressure system fail, how will it affect your landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果右侧和中间的液压系统出现故障将会对降落有什么影响？
cards.referenceText: If that's the case, many systems will be inoperative during landing, such as the normal and alternate brakes, the nose wheel steering, flaps and landing gear normal extension, so we need to extend flaps when landing as alternative, use the accumulator for braking and ask for a tug to tow us to the apron after we stop on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果发生这种情况，许多系统在着陆时都会出现故障，例如正常和备用制动器、前轮转弯、襟翼和起落架收放。所以需要备用放襟翼着陆，刹车时使用蓄能器，并在跑道上停止后请求让拖车将飞机拖到停机坪。

cards.audioText: What would you do in case that the speed brake is inoperative?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机减速板发生故障，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If the speed brake is out of service during flight, we can extend the landing gear to increase the descending rate and reduce the speed. If the speed brake is inoperative after landing, we can use the reverser and maximum brake to stop the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞机减速板在飞行时发生故障，我们可以放下起落架来增加下降率和减小速度。如果飞机减速板在着陆后发生故障，我们可以利于反向制动器达到最大制动使飞机停下。
